fields.summary_ko.0: Visa (V) is expanding its 'Agentic Ready' program for AI-driven commerce platforms with over 140 participating companies including Adyen, PayPal, and Stripe at launch.
fields.summary_ko.1: To enable agent-based purchasing, Visa provides AI agent authentication, tokenized credentials, and fraud prevention capabilities, with participation from over 175 card issuers across 45 markets.
fields.summary_ko.2: Visa's stock price has gained 18.4% since the beginning of the year, while Mastercard and American Express are also investing in enhanced AI agent commerce capabilities.
